Your events come from the calendars on this phone, and their reminders must arrive on time even when the phone saves battery. These steps take a minute, and you can come back to them later.
UltimateCalendar shows and edits the calendars of the accounts on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere by the app.
The system no longer shows its dialog. Open the app settings › Permissions › Calendar and allow it.

No calendars were found on this phone. For Google Calendar, add your Google account in the phone’s Settings › Accounts and make sure Calendar sync is on. For Nextcloud, Radicale or any CalDAV server, install DAVx5 and add the account there. Come back when done: this step disappears as soon as a calendar shows up.
Without them no reminder or invitation can be shown.
The system no longer shows its dialog. Open the notification settings and allow them.
So reminders ring at their minute, not when the system feels like it.
Battery savers delay alarms with the screen off. UltimateCalendar only wakes up for your reminders.

ColorOS (OPPO, OnePlus, realme): open the app settings › Battery usage and turn on “Allow background activity”, “Allow auto launch” and “Allow launch by other apps”. Then, in Recents, lock UltimateCalendar (padlock) so cleaning does not close it.
MIUI / HyperOS: in the app settings, turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to “No restrictions”.
EMUI / HarmonyOS (Huawei, Honor): in Battery › App launch, set UltimateCalendar to “Manage manually” and turn on the three options.
One UI: in Battery, choose “Unrestricted”, and make sure the app is not in “Sleeping apps”.

Funtouch OS / OriginOS: in i Manager › App manager › Autostart, turn on UltimateCalendar; in Battery › Background power consumption, allow it. Then, in Recents, lock the app so cleaning does not close it.
If reminders still arrive late, check the app’s battery settings and allow it to run in the background.

These apps on your phone can remind you of the same events, so each reminder would ring twice. Open each one’s notification settings and turn off its event reminders; UltimateCalendar reminds you instead.
A real reminder, set like any other, arrives in one minute. If it is late or does not come, review the steps above.
